description: Post-processing integrity cases. Every 'segments' value is a transcript Speechmatics recognized CORRECTLY, split the way the realtime API finalizes it. 'expected' is that same clinical content after deterministic normalization. Any mismatch is a defect introduced by our own pipeline, never an ASR error. Cases marked 'streaming_only' reproduce an ASR final boundary inside a written value; joining them with a space (the single-pass view) is not the scenario, so they are scored on the streamed path only.
